Here are some of the best movies of 2023, as highlighted by various critics and sources:

### Top Movies of 2023

1. **Oppenheimer**
   - **Director**: Christopher Nolan
   - **Synopsis**: A biographical drama about J. Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist behind the atomic bomb.
   - **Rating**: 8.2/10 on IMDb [IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt15398776/)

2. **Past Lives**
   - **Director**: Celine Song
   - **Synopsis**: A poignant story of two childhood friends reuniting after years apart, exploring themes of love and destiny.
   - **Rating**: 7.8/10 on IMDb [IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt13238346/)

3. **Poor Things**
   - **Director**: Yorgos Lanthimos
   - **Synopsis**: A fantastical tale of a woman brought back to life by an unorthodox scientist.
   - **Rating**: 7.8/10 on IMDb [IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt14230458/)

4. **The Holdovers**
   - **Director**: Alexander Payne
   - **Synopsis**: Set in a New England boarding school during the 1970s, it follows a curmudgeonly teacher and a troubled student.
   - **Rating**: 7.9/10 on IMDb [IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt14849194/)

5. **Killers of the Flower Moon**
   - **Director**: Martin Scorsese
   - **Synopsis**: A historical drama about the Osage murders in the 1920s and the birth of the FBI.
   - **Rating**: 7.5/10 on IMDb [IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt5537002/)

6. **About Dry Grasses**
   - **Director**: Nuri Bilge Ceylan
   - **Synopsis**: A young teacher in a remote village faces accusations and seeks a new perspective on life.
   - **Rating**: 7.7/10 on IMDb [IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt13231544/)

7. **Anatomy of a Fall**
   - **Director**: Justine Triet
   - **Synopsis**: A woman is accused of her husband's murder, with their son as a key witness.
   - **Rating**: 7.6/10 on IMDb [IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt17009710/)

8. **The Promised Land**
   - **Director**: Nikolaj Arcel
   - **Synopsis**: The story of a Danish soldier and explorer in the mid-18th century.
   - **Rating**: 7.7/10 on IMDb [IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt20561198/)

### Additional Notable Mentions
- **The Zone of Interest**
- **Anatomy of a Fall**
- **The Whale**
- **Barbie** (noted for its cultural impact and box office success)

These films have been recognized for their storytelling, direction, and performances, making them stand out in 2023's cinematic landscape. For a more comprehensive list, you can check out sources like [IndieWire](https://www.indiewire.com/gallery/50-best-movies-of-2023-critics-survey/) and [CriticsTop10](https://criticstop10.com/best-movies-of-2023/).
